tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bsam yas pho lha skya ser gsol mchod dge/ kyai/ jo rgyal dkar po ser khang dgra lha che/ /pho lha skya ser mtshan can 'khor bcas rnams/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang ha ho hrīḥs brlabs pa'i/ /khams gsum yid 'phrog mchod gtor 'di bzhes shig /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ ādya nutpanna twad oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum sogs kyis bsngos/ kyai/ jo rgyal ser khang skya ser 'khor bcas la/ /so so'i thugs bskyed smon lam las byung ba'i/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin bzhed don ltar/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul 'di bzhes nyams chags bshags/ /khyed la phrin las snyan du gsol ba ni/ /bstan 'gro'i dpal skyed bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /'go zhing 'ches nas nad gdon dgra bgegs sgrol/ /tshe ring nad med dpal 'byor lhun grub mdzod/ /phrin las glog ltar myur ba'i lha rnams kyis/ /sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rab bstod pas/ /dges shing brtse ba'i sdong grogs mi g.yel bas/ /bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// //ces 'di skya ser sku rten pa/ phrin las dbang mo'i bskul don bzhin/ re skong nyung ngur sa skya pa/ kun blos 'on chos dgon par bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 klu sgrub/ bsam yas pho lha skya ser gsol mchod/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
